title: Quality Engineering (QE) Manager - Playwright test automation experience
description:
**Description**
 Quality Engineering (QE) Manager \- Playwright test automation experience
   

  

 Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
   

  

 Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
   

  

 Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
   

  

 Why Syneos Health
   

  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.


**Job Responsibilities**
* Lead and mentor Quality Engineering teams across multiple projects and initiatives
* Drive automation\-first testing practices using Provar for Salesforce platforms
* Define and implement QE strategies aligned with Agile and CI/CD delivery models
* Oversee test planning, automation coverage, regression strategy, and release readiness
* Collaborate with Product Owners and Engineering teams during backlog refinement and sprint planning
* Establish and improve QE governance, standards, and best practices
* Support modernization initiatives including shift\-left testing and SDLC/PDLC process improvements
* Ensure proper requirements traceability and defect management practices
* Participate in hiring, mentoring, and performance management of QE team members
* Partner with DevOps teams to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines
* Provide delivery metrics, defect analytics, and executive\-level reporting
* Support regulated/GxP validation processes where applicable


**Get to know Syneos Health**
 Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.
   

  

 No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
   

  

 http://www.syneoshealth.com
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.
   

  

**Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Quality Engineering Manager with deep expertise in GxP\-compliant quality practices and Playwright\-based test automation. This role will lead and mature our Quality Engineering organization, driving automation strategy, quality governance, and continuous improvement across a portfolio of enterprise applications. This role will be responsible for driving automation\-first testing strategies, improving release quality, modernizing testing practices, and leading QE resources across Agile delivery teams. The ideal candidate will combine hands\-on automation expertise with leadership, delivery oversight, and strategic thinking. The QE Manager will work closely with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Validation, and Business stakeholders to ensure scalable, reliable, and high\-quality software delivery.

title: Lead Engineer - Cloud Engineering
description:
**About Us**
 Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
   

  

 At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
**About the Role**
 We are looking for a hands\-on AWS Lead Engineer to lead cloud modernization, engineering excellence, and AI\-driven innovation for our Provider Payments platform. This role will work across all Provider Engineering Pods, driving scalable solutions, reusable capabilities, and modernization of healthcare payment systems while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of secure, scalable, cloud\-native solutions on AWS.
* Drive modernization of .NET applications into microservices and event\-driven architectures.
* Partner across all Provider Engineering Pods to establish engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices.
* Champion AI\-driven engineering practices to improve developer productivity, code quality, testing, observability, and operational efficiency.
* Influence technical roadmaps, architecture decisions, and cloud transformation initiatives.
* Mentor engineers and promote a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Security, and Operations teams to deliver business outcomes.
* Drive operational excellence through automation, reliability engineering, and proactive monitoring.


**Technical Expertise**
* Strong AWS experience with EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, CloudWatch, IAM, and VPC.
* Deep expertise in.NET Core / .NET 6\+, C\#, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, and distributed systems.
* Strong understanding of Microservices, Event\-Driven Architecture, Domain\-Driven Design, and API\-first development.
* Experience with SQL Server, NoSQL databases, messaging platforms, and high\-volume transaction systems.
* Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform/CloudFormation, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Knowledge of cloud security, authentication, authorization, and secure engineering practices.
* Experience building highly available and resilient payment platforms.


**AI\-Driven Engineering Mindset**
* Passion for leveraging AI and GenAI tools to accelerate software development lifecycle activities.
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools for coding, testing, code reviews, documentation, and engineering productivity.
* Ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve operational efficiency, developer experience, and platform intelligence.
* Drive a culture of experimentation, automation, and data\-driven decision making.
* Curiosity to continuously learn emerging AI capabilities and apply them responsibly within engineering teams.


 Domain Experience
   

  

**Preferred Experience In**
* Provider Payments
* Healthcare Claims
* Payment Integrity
* Revenue Cycle Management
* Healthcare Financial Platforms


 Behavioral Competencies
   

  

* Ownership mindset with strong accountability.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence across teams without direct authority.
* Growth mindset and passion for mentoring others.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving results.
* Customer\-focused with a bias for action and execution excellence.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 8\-12 years of software engineering experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience in AWS and .NET technologies.
* Experience leading cloud modernization and large\-scale engineering initiatives.
* Agile delivery experience and strong cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* AWS certifications preferred.


 Ideal Candidate: A technology leader with deep AWS and .NET expertise, healthcare payment domain knowledge, an AI\-first engineering mindset, and the ability to influence and collaborate across all Provider Engineering Pods while living Zelis' IMPACT values.
   

  

**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
   

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
   

  

**Accessibility Support**
 We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

title: Software Engr II
description:
**Job Description**
 As an Advanced V\&V Engineer here at Honeywell, you will develop verification and validation strategies, influence product development, mentor teams, and ensure compliance with regulatory standards
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key responsibilities:**
* Develop and maintain full stack applications using React and .NET CORE, ensuring high performance and responsiveness.
* Collaborate with UX/UI designers to implement user\-friendly interfaces and improve overall user experience.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to team knowledge sharing to enhance software quality.
* Implement responsive UIs with React that meet our customers' needs and are well\-integrated with the backend services.
* Collaborate with product management and other stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions


**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**
* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as science, technology, engineering, mathematics.
* 4\+ years of experience in front\-end development with a focus on React.
* Strong understanding of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Experience with state management libraries such as Redux or Context API.
* Familiarity with RESTful APIs and modern front\-end build pipelines and tools.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure DevOps, Azure Functions, and Azure SQL Database.
* Knowledge of modern front\-end build pipelines and tools.
* Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git.
* Experience with database technologies such as SQL Server, Entity Framework, and NoSQL databases.
* Understanding microservices architecture and containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.


**WE VALUE**
* Advanced degree in Computer Science or related field.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team\-oriented environment.
* Passion for learning new technologies and staying updated with industry trends


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.
